runs.content: Global Payments closed at a new 52-week high on reports that CD&R and GTCR are exploring a ~$40bn take-private and a Q3 Worldpay-synergy raise, a payments momentum entry with a bid floor that diversifies the healthcare-heavy book; SHEL was trimmed for capacity at −0.89%.

Inditex sits near its first-ever €60 close on H1 FY26 sales +9.2% at constant currency, as consumer discretionary leads the quarter and led today's risk-on rebound; the book's first BME name adds non-US, non-healthcare diversification, and PFE was trimmed for capacity at −2.18%.
